summary: Human tasks are assigned to users, permissions, roles and groups and support a quorum with veto outcomes, delegation and escalation steps; adds Engine.DelegateTask and Engine.Tasks (inbox), workflow.TaskAudience with a core implementation, TaskObservers via wiring.ContributeTaskObservers, GET /tasks and POST /tasks/{id}/delegate, and a migration that backfills assignees and decisions of existing tasks.
